question: From what date must ministry departments run their work on the e-office system?
gold_answer: From 01-04-2023, per the standard operating procedure circular of 23-02-2023 (which cites a circular of 02-02-2023 not in this corpus). The 2020 mahaeoffice GR and SOP (19-10-2020, 09-11-2020) came earlier

product.answer: The 19-10-2020 GR directs that the mahaeoffice web-based system must be implemented immediately in all ministerial departments. It further mandates that from 01-11-2020, e-Dharika must be fully operationalised in the listed ministerial departments, and thereafter all ministerial departments must start using the e-office system in a phased manner. The 09-11-2020 GR fixes the SOP for this implementation but does not state a new compliance date for ministry departments. The 23-02-2023 GR states that e-office system use must be made effective from 01-04-2023 in all ministry administrative departments and regional offices, and that e-postal/e-holidays must be sent through e-office from that date, with physical mail sent only by hand where e-office is not possible. No newer GR in the corpus amends, replaces, stays, extends or clarifies the 19-10-2020 GR; the 2023 GR concerns SOP procedure rather than the original directive date.

product.answer: The 2020-10-19 GR mandates that all ministry departments run their work on the e-office system from 01-11-2020. The later SOP GR of 09-11-2020 clarifies the procedure but does not alter that date. Earlier, the 2020-10-19 GR listed specific departments for the first phase and required e-post/e-holidays from 1.11.2020, while the ministry e-office system was to be fully implemented in phased manner thereafter.

cited.title: Use of mahaeoffice portal for of official work.
cited.quote: सर्व मंत्रालयीन विभागातील अधिकारी / कर्मचारी यांना यापूर्वी ई-ऑफीस प्रणालीचे प्रशिक्षण देण्यात आले आहे। तथापि, त्या अनुषंगाने काही तांत्रिक सहाय्य / प्रशिक्षणाची पुन्हा आवश्यकता भासल्यास माहिती तंत्रज्ञान विभागातील ई-ऑफीसशी संबंधित नोडल अधिकारी तसेच ई-ऑफीस सपोर्ट टीमकडे संपर्क साधावा। ई-ऑफीस प्रणालीची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी करण्याच्या दृष्टीने पुढील टप्प्यात खालीलप्रमाणे कार्यवाही करण्यात यावी।

cited.title: SOP for use of mahaeoffice portal for of official work.
cited.quote: मंत्रालयात ई-ऑफीस प्रणालीचा प्रभावीपणे वापर करण्याचा निर्णय घेण्यात आला आहे। याकरिता एन.आय.सी.च्या ई-ऑफीस (URL) mahaeoffice1.maharashtra. gov.in या प्रणालीची अंमलबजा<arg_value>implementation करण्याबाबत संदर्भाधीन शासन निर्णयान्वये आदेश निर्गमित करण्यात आले आहेत। त्याअनुषंगाने मंत्रालयात ई-ऑफीस प्रणाली कार्यान्वित करण्यासाठी आवश्यक असलेली प्रमाण कार्यपध्दती (S.O.P.) निश्चित करण्यात आली असून ती विवरणपत्र-अ (Annexure-1)प्रमाणे आहे।
